summary: Phoenix Education Partners (NYSE: PXED) disclosed on Form 8-K that on September 16, 2026 it agreed to acquire Fuel50 Inc., an AI-powered workforce transformation platform, via merger of CEG Merger Sub into Fuel50, which survives as a wholly-owned subsidiary. Aggregate cash consideration is approximately $31.5 million, subject to customary working capital, cash, debt and expense adjustments, plus up to $8.5 million of earnouts through calendar 2027 tied to performance milestones. Funded from cash on hand; closing expected within 30 days pending Fuel50 stockholder approval. No board recommendation or advisor named; deal is small and all-cash, limiting arb dynamics—watch earnout triggers and closing conditions.
